note: deuxième contrat de crédit modifié et refondu avec Coinbase Credit, Inc. (prêteur, agent des sûretés et agent administratif) : prêt à terme garanti à tirages multiples jusqu'à 200 M$, taux fixe au lieu d'un taux variable, échéance reportée de 364 jours après l'échéance d'origine, prorogeable de 364 jours avec l'accord du prêteur
quote: The Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement continues the Company's multiple draw down secured term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of up to $200 million (the "Loan") and amends the Existing Credit Agreement, among other things, to change the rate per annum at which interest accrues on the Loan from a floating rate to a fixed rate and to extend the maturity of the Loan.

note: nantissement des actifs financiers de la société (bitcoins, USDC, trésorerie) conservés par Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC
quote: The Company's obligations under the Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement continue to be secured by a pledge of the Company's financial assets, including bitcoin, USDC and cash, held in the custody of Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC.
